parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing structural support for all other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal water channels and connects the spout, switch, and other components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable base for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the outlet tube of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water stream from the faucet to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may swivel in some designs to adjust water direction.

parts.name: Cylinder (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The cylinder is a small auxiliary part, often used to control or support the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a connector or actuator for the internal water control system.
parts.Movement_description: It may move slightly when the switch is operated, depending on the faucet design.
